stem: Which of the following is an example of a non-IgE-mediated food allergy?
explanation: Food protein-induced enterocolitis syndrome (FPIES) is a non-IgE-mediated food allergy. It typically causes delayed gastrointestinal symptoms after ingestion of the trigger food.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because lactose intolerance is a food intolerance due to impaired lactose digestion, not an immune-mediated food allergy.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because peanut-induced anaphylaxis is a classic IgE-mediated allergic reaction.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because FPIES is a non-IgE-mediated food allergy that typically presents with delayed vomiting and lethargy after exposure to a trigger food.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because oral allergy syndrome is usually an IgE-mediated pollen-food allergy syndrome rather than a non-IgE-mediated food allergy.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because coeliac disease is an immune-mediated disorder triggered by gluten, but it is not a food allergy.

source.hint: Look for conditions characterized by delayed, non-antibody-driven responses.
